en: Multiview postcard featuring Secu Monastery in a wooded valley and several liturgical objects: a 17th‑century chalice, a 19th‑century holy water vessel, a printed homiliary of Metropolitan Varlaam (1643), a 19th‑century paten/plate, and a 19th‑century gospel with ornate cover. Front titles read "MÎNĂSTIREA SECU" and "JUDEȚUL NEAMȚ". The reverse has multilingual captions and the imprint of the Metropolis of Moldavia and Suceava in Iași.
